name: Mio no Mystery Adventure
original_name: ミオのミステリーアドベンチャー
source:
You get caught in the rain and hide in the mansion. Upon entry you hear "I've got a present for you - It's your death!" Now you got to solve puzzles, defeat devil, the master of the house and find a way out.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1983.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
你在外面遇上大雨，便躲进一座宅邸避雨。才刚进门，你就听见一道声音：“我为你准备了一份礼物——那就是你的死！”如今，你必须解开谜题，击败这座宅邸的主人——恶魔，并找到逃离此地的方法。

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1983.html]vndbreview[/url]]
